items.title: Entrepreneurship in Pakistan and the Digital Economy (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Entrepreneurship in Pakistan and the Digital Economy (PDF 131, printed 127).

blocks.text: Internet aur mobile technology tak barhti rasai ki wajah se Pakistan mein entrepreneurship tezi se barh rahi hai. Bohat se naujawan social media, e-commerce platforms aur freelancing websites ke zariye online karobar shuru kar rahe hain. Digital economy (digital maeeshat) software development, digital marketing aur online services jaise shobon mein rozgar ke naye mauqe paida kar rahi hai. Hukoomat aur private idare bhi startups aur innovation ki madad kar rahe hain. Yeh taraqqi mulk ki maeeshat behtar kar rahi hai aur naujawanon ko naukri dhoondne ki bajaye naukriyan dene wala banne par aamada kar rahi hai.

blocks.prompt: Pakistan mein entrepreneurship tezi se kyun barh rahi hai, aur digital economy kin shobon mein naukriyan bana rahi hai?
blocks.explanation: Internet aur mobile technology tak zyada rasai ki wajah se. Naukriyan: software development, digital marketing aur online services. Is se nojawan job seekers ke bajaye job creators ban rahe hain.

items: Pakistan: social media, e-commerce aur freelancing se online karobar.
Hukoomat aur private initiatives startups ki madad kar rahe hain.
